Grizzly Man | Grizzly Man is a 2005 American documentary film by German director Werner Herzog.  It chronicles the life and death of bear enthusiast Timothy Treadwell. Timothy Treadwell | Timothy Treadwell (born Timothy William Dexter; April 29, 1957 October 6, 2003) was an American bear enthusiast, environmentalist, documentary filmmaker, and founder of the bear-protection organization Grizzly People. At the end of his 13th summer in the park, in 2003, he and his girlfriend Amie Huguenard were killed by a 28-year-old brown bear, whose stomach was later found to contain human remains and clothing.  Treadwell's life, work, and death were the subject of Werner Herzog's critically acclaimed documentary film "Grizzly Man" (2005).

If You're Going Through Hell (Before the Devil Even Knows) | If You're Going Through Hell (Before the Devil Even Knows)
The Devil's Party | The Devil's Party is a 1938 American crime film directed by Ray McCarey based on the Borden Chase novel "Hells' Kitchen Has a Pantry".
Girlfriend from Hell | Girlfriend From Hell is a 1989 American comedy-horror film that was written and directed by Daniel M. Peterson.  The film had its world premiere on April 24, 1989 at the Houston Film Festival and was released to video in August of the following year.  It starred Dana Ashbrook and Liane Curtis, and follows a young high school girl who is possessed by the Devil in order to steal souls.
